description: Mobile techniques used by NGate, ATT&CK software S9040 (v1.0)
name: NGate (S9040)

techniques.comment: [NGate](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9040) has used TCP sockets to communicate with the C2 server.(Citation: CERTPL_NGate_Nov2025)

[NGate](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9040) has used TLS to communicate with the C2 server.(Citation: CERTPL_NGate_Nov2025) [NGate](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9040) has also used HTTP to communicate with the C2 server.(Citation: ESETStefanko_NGateVariant_Apr2026)

[NGate](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9040) has used Java to execute a variety of actions, such as loading and verifying runtime configuration and disabling the launcher if decryption or parsing failed.(Citation: CERTPL_NGate_Nov2025)

[NGate](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9040) has been distributed via files[.]fm and through fake websites that mimic legitimate services, such as banking websites and Rio de Prêmios, a lottery website.(Citation: ESETStefankoOsmani_NGate_Aug2024)(Citation: CERTPL_NGate_Nov2025)(Citation: ESETStefanko_NGateVariant_Apr2026)
[NGate](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9040) has exfiltrated the victim’s payment card PIN to the C2 server via HTTP.(Citation: ESETStefanko_NGateVariant_Apr2026)
[NGate](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9040) has displayed a fake website to collect the user’s banking information.(Citation: ESETStefankoOsmani_NGate_Aug2024)

[NGate](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9040) has used a WhatsApp profile image that impersonated Caixa Econômica Federal, Brazil’s government-owned bank that manages majority of lotteries.(Citation: ESETStefanko_NGateVariant_Apr2026)

[NGate](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9040) has decrypted ASCII-hex data from the `assets/___` resource, which resulted in a config file that has the host IP address, port, `sharedToken`, and more.(Citation: CERTPL_NGate_Nov2025)

[NGate](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9040) has used NFC to send the victim's card information through a server to an adversary-controlled device.(Citation: ESETStefankoOsmani_NGate_Aug2024)(Citation: CERTPL_NGate_Nov2025)(Citation: ESETStefanko_NGateVariant_Apr2026)

[NGate](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9040) has been delivered using malicious links from phishing emails and SMS messages as well as malicious websites that mimic Czech banks.(Citation: ESETStefankoOsmani_NGate_Aug2024)(Citation: CERTPL_NGate_Nov2025) [NGate](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9040) has also been distributed through a website impersonating a Brazilian lottery (“Rio de Prêmios”) and a fake Google Play web page (“Proteção Cartão”).(Citation: ESETStefanko_NGateVariant_Apr2026)
[NGate](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9040) has requested for the `ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE` permission.(Citation: CERTPL_NGate_Nov2025)
